message: 食べてはいけない

name: Eddie
message: 「Well then, I'm heading off to Prier.」

name: Synn
message: 「Good luck out there!」

name: Eddie
message: 「Today's the day I finally score that yakisoba bread!」
The mega-sized cabbage bread is pretty tasty too, though.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sacchin, shall we head out too?」

name: Synn
message: 「Going to Prier? That's rare.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehh, we're not having bento today~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Listen up. We talked about this yesterday, remember?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ahh. Right, right~ That's right~」

name: Synn
message: 「Something going on?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We have a Sweets Club meeting during lunch break.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It's a secret discussion we can't tell Synn-kun about~」

name: Synn
message: 「A secret?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No. It's not really a secret, it's just more of a surprise if you don't know what we're serving, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, you have to submit your plans beforehand, so I'm going to find out anyway, you know?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「One bite and it'll send you straight to heavennn.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's that dangerous?! No way, you can't make something like that!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's totally edible! I think, so don't worry. Probably.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「But, our first--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Mghhhmph.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We're the ones who'll embarrass ourselves if it flops, so don't you worry about it, Synn!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Anyway, see you later!」
Are they preparing some kind of secret menu item? Might actually be a little exciting.
Now then, guess I'll head over to the Student Council room.
